children: Shares of Skyworks Solutions slipped after the company logged lower revenue and profit in its latest quarter.
The stock slid 16%, to $71.59, in after-hours trading Tuesday. Through the close, shares were up 35% this year.
Revenue in the fiscal fourth quarter fell 5%, to $1.05 billion.
Profit also slid to $23.4 million, or 15 cents a share, from $141.4 million, or 94 cents a share, the year before.
Adjusted earnings per share were $1.28, 1 cent ahead of analysts' projections.

The company recently closed its combination with Qorvo, which is expected to bring greater scale and technology breadth, Chief Executive Phil Brace said. The latest results are only for the standalone Skyworks business.
Skyworks also said it expects revenue from its smartphone business to decline sequentially due to softness in the Android market.
